caption: : Avg. rate at which the model attends most to each input segment: context, generated response, or other (e.g., system prompts) during generation.
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the average rate at which a model attends most to each input segment during generation, specifically comparing the distribution of attention across three categories: context, generated response, and other. The horizontal axis represents two models being compared, labeled "Ours" and "Standard", while the vertical axis represents the percentage of attention, with a scale ranging from 0% to approximately 60%, although the exact upper limit is not explicitly shown. The chart features grouped bars for each model, with blue bars representing context, orange bars representing generated response, and green bars representing other. For the "Ours" model, the blue bar is approximately 60.6%, the orange bar is around 31.7%, and the green bar is about 7.7%. In contrast, the "Standard" model has a blue bar of roughly 23.6%, an orange bar of approximately 51.1%, and a green bar of around 25.3%. The bars are not sorted in any specific order, and there is no visual emphasis on any of the bars beyond their standard representation.
